study: Architecture comparison 1: CRNN vs frozen CNN baseline (validation only)
research_question: Does explicitly modeling temporal structure improve respiratory-cycle classification compared with the frozen CNN baseline?
reference_run: baseline_cnn_v3 (frozen official CNN baseline: lr 1e-4, dropout 0.3, best validation macro-F1 0.4271)

architecture.cnn_front_end: 3 blocks x [Conv3x3-MaskedGN-ReLU-Conv3x3-MaskedGN-ReLU-MaxPool], channels 16/32/64, pooling (freq,time) (2,2),(2,1),(2,1); freq 64->8; time step 20 ms
architecture.frequency_collapse: flatten 64 ch x 8 bins -> Linear(512,128) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.3)
architecture.pooling: masked additive attention (256->64 tanh ->1), softmax over valid steps
architecture.head: Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(256,4)

comparison: paired patient-bootstrap 95% CI of the macro-F1 difference (crnn_v1 - baseline_cnn_v3)
subgroups by device and original sample rate (reported only, not used for selection)
rules: no CRNN hyperparameter tuning after seeing validation results
test split never loaded or evaluated
